labels.doneHint: Only mark this once the deliverable exists and someone else could use it.

phases.title: Validate
phases.summary: Prove that someone has the problem before writing code.

phases.title: Build the MVP
phases.summary: The smallest product that solves one painful job end to end.

phases.title: Launch
phases.summary: Get the first users, charge them, and listen.

nodes.title: Customer interviews
nodes.summary: Talk to people who have the problem. Ask about what they did in the past, not what they think of your idea.
nodes.challenge: Run 8 interviews and write a one page summary of the 3 most repeated pains.
nodes.success: At least 5 interviewees described the same pain without being prompted.

nodes.title: Landing page and waitlist
nodes.summary: A one page promise and a way to sign up, to measure real interest.
nodes.challenge: Publish a landing page and send 100 relevant people to it.
nodes.success: You know your visitor to signup rate and have at least 20 emails.

nodes.title: Pre-sell test
nodes.summary: Ask for money before the product exists.
nodes.challenge: Offer 5 interviewees a paid early access spot.

nodes.title: MVP scope
nodes.summary: Pick one user, one job and one happy path. Everything else goes on the later list.
nodes.challenge: A one page scope doc with a single user story and clickable wireframes.
nodes.success: A stranger can say what the product does after 30 seconds with the wireframes.

nodes.title: Stack and skeleton
nodes.summary: Choose boring tools you already know. Get auth, database and deploy working on day one.
nodes.challenge: A hello world with login and one table, deployed to a public URL.

tasks.title: Pick a host and create the project
Create the first table and a migration
Deploy on every push to main
tasks.note: Keep the pipeline under five minutes.

nodes.title: Core feature
nodes.summary: Build the happy path end to end, with an ugly UI if needed.
nodes.challenge: A user can sign up and complete the main job without help.
nodes.success: Two testers complete the main job while you stay silent.

nodes.title: Payments
nodes.summary: Charge from day one, even if it is a single plan.
nodes.challenge: A test mode payment unlocks the product.
nodes.success: Subscribing, cancelling and failed payments all behave correctly in test mode.

nodes.title: Guided onboarding
nodes.summary: A checklist or short tour that gets users to their first success faster.

nodes.title: Private beta
nodes.summary: Invite the waitlist in small batches and watch how people actually use it.
nodes.challenge: Onboard 10 users and talk to at least 5 of them.
nodes.success: A prioritized list of fixes, backed by what real users did.

nodes.title: Public launch
nodes.summary: Announce where your users already spend time and ask for the first payment.
nodes.challenge: Post the launch in three places and reply to every comment.
nodes.success: Your first paying user, and a retention number to track from here.
